name: Starter A: where is their attention?
engine: Keep the ball away from Oyarzabal so a centre-back stays on him, and let Fabián and Olmo take what was meant for him.
about: The watched man. At the start of each attack a centre-back of theirs goes wherever Oyarzabal goes (Decoy): until Oyarzabal touches the ball, anything through him is -2 and a move by anyone else against one of their defenders in their half is +1. In their half, a pass or cross meant for the watched man goes to Fabián instead, at +2 (Arrives late); a pull-back or a ball across the goal stays with its man. Every cut-back and low cross goes to Olmo (Nominated receiver). Guessing is on for both teams in every match: their defence remembers the last kind of move each of your players tried.
decisions: Keep the ball away from Oyarzabal: the moment he touches it, the +1 is over for that attack.
Play the pass to the watched man on purpose when Fabián is on the pitch: it goes to Fabián at +2.
Rotate who delivers the cut-back to Olmo: the deliverer who repeats himself gets read.
